description_en: Revokes authorization records for specified users and user groups based on portal menu IDs
description_zh: 根据门户菜单ID，取消指定用户、用户组的授权记录
name: CancelAuthorizationMenu

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data portal
parameters.name: data_portal_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the leaf node menus in the data portal.

You can specify multiple IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 100 IDs can be specified at a time
parameters.help_zh:
数据门户的叶子节点菜单ID。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为100
parameters.name: menu_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the user groups.

You can specify multiple IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 200 IDs can be specified at a time.
UserGroupIds and UserIds cannot be empty at the same time
parameters.help_zh:
用户组ID列表。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为200
UserGroupIds和UserIds不能同时为空
parameters.name: user_group_ids

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the users. These are Quick BI user IDs, not Alibaba Cloud UIDs.

You can specify multiple IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). A maximum of 200 IDs can be specified at a time
parameters.help_zh:
用户ID列表。此处为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID。

支持批量传参，ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开，批量修改的最大数为200
parameters.name: user_ids

Result.description_en: The number of menus for which authorization was successfully revoked
Result.description_zh: 取消授权成功的菜单数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true: The request was successful.
false: The request failed
Success.description_zh:
是否请求成功。取值范围：

true：请求成功
false：请求失败
